lessons.never_claim: Never claim that smart-beta factor funds will beat the broad market index across every market cycle.

level_tagline: The Persona Masterclass: Designing Solutions for 8 Real Indian Households
phase: Phase 6: Advanced Capabilities, Real Personas & Certification

lessons.title: Persona 1 & 2: The 24-Year-Old IT Fresher & The Married Tech Professional
subtopics: Rajesh (24, Salaried, ₹40k/month): High risk capacity, 20-year horizon, ₹5,000 surplus -> Flexi Cap + Step-Up SIP
Handling the crypto/options trading temptation: Teaching Rajesh why boring SIPs create lasting wealth
Sunil & Priya (35, Married, 1 child): Home loan EMI, school fees, ₹15,000 monthly surplus
Dual Goal Architecture: Child Higher Education (12 years) + Family Retirement (25 years)
Designing an asset-allocated mix: 70% Equity (Flexi/Large-Mid) + 20% BAF + 10% Liquid buffer
lessons.know: A young earner's greatest financial asset is time; their portfolio should focus overwhelmingly on broad equity.
lessons.understand: Mid-career married couples need ring-fenced goal buckets so home loan pressures don't derail retirement.
lessons.do: Build a complete 2-goal SIP proposal for Sunil & Priya in Turtlemint Ninja.
lessons.say: "Rajesh ji, 20 saal mein compounding ka asli jaadu dekhne ke liye disciplined SIP sabse powerful tool hai."
lessons.never_claim: Never sell high-commission closed-ended schemes or sectoral funds to first-time earning freshers.

lessons.title: Persona 3 & 4: The Conservative Homemaker & The Pre-Retiree
subtopics: Meena ji (44, Homemaker): Starting first investment with ₹3,000 household savings; high fear of loss
The Gentle Onboarding: Starting with an Arbitrage or Conservative Hybrid fund before introducing equity
Vikram (58, PSU Employee, retiring in 2 years): Received ₹50 Lakh gratuity/PF corpus
Designing the SWP Engine: ₹30 Lakh in BAF/Equity Savings + ₹20 Lakh in Short-Duration/Banking PSU Debt
Setting up a tax-efficient monthly SWP of ₹35,000 providing a regular pension-like cash flow
lessons.know: A retiree must never have 100% of their life savings in volatile equity schemes.
lessons.understand: Meena ji needs an experience of absolute capital safety in Year 1 to build trust before stepping into equity.
lessons.do: Structure an SWP cash flow schedule for Vikram on Turtlemint Pro showing post-tax monthly cash flow.
lessons.say: "Vikram ji, aapka mool corpus safe rahega aur har mahine pension ki tarah bank mein paisa transfer hota rahega."
lessons.never_claim: Never put a senior citizen's entire retirement gratuity into Small Cap funds chasing high returns.

level_tagline: Arming the DP: Dismantling 14 Pervasive Indian Financial Fallacies
phase: Phase 6: Advanced Capabilities, Real Personas & Certification

lessons.title: Mythbusters Part 1: NAV, NFOs, Demat & Product Myths
subtopics: Myth 1: '₹10 NAV is cheaper than ₹100 NAV' -> BUSTED: Mathematically identical percentage growth
Myth 2: 'NFO is an IPO and offers a bargain entry' -> BUSTED: NFO holds un-invested cash at launch
Myth 3: 'Mutual funds require a Demat account' -> BUSTED: Statement of Account (SOA) is simpler, cheaper, and paperless
Myth 4: 'SIP is a unique government product' -> BUSTED: SIP is merely an automated recurring purchase route
Myth 5: 'Mutual funds are only for wealthy rich people' -> BUSTED: You can start with just ₹100 or ₹500 a month
lessons.know: NFOs carry zero track record; an existing scheme with a 10-year audited history is infinitely more verifiable.
lessons.understand: Demystifying these basic myths instantly elevates the DP's credibility above local uneducated agents.
lessons.do: Use the Mythbuster Flashcard deck inside the Turtlemint Ninja app during customer presentations.
lessons.say: "NFO sasta nahi hota—jaise ₹100 ka note 10 sikkon mein badalne se daulat nahi badhti, waise hi NAV hoti hai."
lessons.never_claim: Never promote an NFO as an 'exclusive low-cost initial offer' to drive sales.

lessons.title: Mythbusters Part 2: Returns, Safety & Crash Fallacies
subtopics: Myth 6: 'SIP ensures you can never lose money' -> BUSTED: SIP averages cost, but markets can still fall
Myth 7: 'Debt mutual funds are risk-free like bank FDs' -> BUSTED: Debt funds carry credit and duration risks
Myth 8: 'Past 1-year top performer will remain #1 next year' -> BUSTED: Historical mean reversion causes leadership rotation
Myth 9: 'Buying 15 different mutual funds gives great diversification' -> BUSTED: Causes portfolio clutter and duplication
Myth 10: 'Market is at an all-time high, so stop all SIPs immediately' -> BUSTED: Markets hit new highs dozens of times in growing economies
lessons.know: Holding more than 4-5 equity funds leads to extreme stock overlap without adding diversification.
lessons.understand: Stopping an SIP because markets hit an all-time high deprives the investor of participating in continuing bull runs.
lessons.do: Run a portfolio overlap check on Turtlemint Pro showing two funds holding the exact same 70% stocks.
lessons.say: "15 fund lene se diversification nahi, sirf khichdi banti hai—4-5 acche funds kaafi hote hain."
lessons.never_claim: Never claim that an SIP completely immunizes an investor against temporary capital drawdowns.

level_tagline: The Gateway to Distribution: Factsheet Lab, Field Simulation & Ethical Clearance
phase: Phase 6: Advanced Capabilities, Real Personas & Certification

lessons.title: The Factsheet Diagnostic Exam
subtopics: Extracting 6 key metrics from an unlabelled real-world factsheet within 4 minutes
Identifying benchmark underperformance and portfolio concentration red flags
Calculating net in-hand returns after factoring in TER, exit load, and applicable capital gains tax
Categorization compliance check: Flagging when a fund drifts outside its SEBI mandate
Writing a 3-bullet factual summary of scheme suitability for a hypothetical customer
lessons.know: A certified Turtlemint DP must be capable of diagnosing any AMC factsheet without external assistance.
lessons.understand: This test ensures no partner recommends a fund blindly without checking its underlying holdings and risks.
lessons.do: Score at least 80% on the Turtlemint Ninja Factsheet Diagnostic Exam.
lessons.say: "Main factsheet dekh kar aapko bata sakta hoon ki is fund ki asli strategy aur risk level kya hai."
lessons.never_claim: Cheating or sharing exam answer keys will lead to immediate disqualification from the partner program.

lessons.title: The Audio-Visual Customer Conversation Capstone
subtopics: Handling an angry customer whose portfolio is down 9% after 6 months: Validating and reassuring
Handling a customer demanding: 'Mujhe bas guaranteed 15% return wala fund do'
Handling a customer asking: 'Direct plan mein commission nahi lagta, main aapse kyun loon?'
Complete diagnostic discovery interview: Asking all 5 mandatory fact-finding questions
Final Compliance Gate: Zero return promises, zero competitor badmouthing, full commission transparency
lessons.know: Passing the conversational capstone certifies that the DP speaks with professional empathy, truth, and compliance.
lessons.understand: Knowledge without conversational capability is useless in the field; this capstone tests real-world execution.
lessons.do: Record and submit a 3-minute video response solving a difficult customer objection scenario.
lessons.say: "Aapke sapne aur aapka vishwas hamari zimmedari hai—hum hamesha sach aur sahi guidance denge."
lessons.never_claim: Any promise of guaranteed returns during the video capstone results in an automatic, non-appealable FAIL.
